_README: TRANCHE 8 - PATCH. Restructures the closing frame loaded in tranche 7.
Two changes, both verified against source on 2026-09-01:
1. CLOSING STATEMENT (template para 218) split three ways.
The single body SHELL_CLOSING_STATEMENT__ntd__v1__closing_statement is SUPERSEDED.
The '[DELETE PRECEDING SENTENCE IF NOT USING STARBUCKS STANDARD FORM LEASE]' instruction
governs exactly ONE mid-paragraph sentence. applies_when is position-level, so that
sentence is promoted to its own position gated on lease/L0 is_selected.
VERIFIED: Powder Springs uses the Starbucks standard lease and KEPT the sentence.
2. TENANT SIGNATURE BLOCK is a THREE-WAY ALTERNATIVE SET, not a fill.
The single body SHELL_TENANT_BLOCK__ntd__v1__tenant_signature_block is SUPERSEDED.
The tranche-7 note on sig_tenant_title was wrong: it claimed Powder Springs and
Douglasville both use 'Representative Name / Title: Broker' with the SDM cc'd.
They do not. They are two DIFFERENT blocks, and neither matches the template.
SIG0 = template as drafted (SDM signs, no broker lines, no cc)
SIG1 = Powder Springs 8/11/2026 (SDM signs, two broker lines appended, NO cc)
SIG2 = Douglasville 8/31/2026 (broker signs 'representing', SDM cc'd, no SDM line)
POWDER SPRINGS ACCEPTANCE TEST RESOLVES TO SIG1.
TWO THINGS I NEED FROM CLAUDE CODE - do not guess on my behalf:
(a) PARAGRAPH GROUPING. F1/F2/F3 are three positions that compose ONE template
paragraph (218). I have encoded document order as emit_order 100/101/102, but
the schema has no field that says 'these positions share a paragraph'. Without
one the assembler cannot distinguish 'concatenate' from 'new paragraph', and
emit_order alone will not survive the signature block being appended after.
Proposal: add a nullable integer `template_paragraph` to the position (the sweep
manifest already supplies the index for every paragraph). Your call - if you
prefer a different mechanism, tell me and I will re-key. DO NOT infer grouping
from emit_order adjacency; that breaks the first time a paragraph gets a fourth
fragment.
(b) BRACE CODES. SIG0/SIG1/SIG2 are PROVISIONAL codes I minted - they do not appear
in the template, which has no {XX} marker on the signature block. Marked
code_status 'provisional'. If provisional codes on an alternative set are not
acceptable, say so and I will re-key with brace_code null + selector_value.
SUPERSEDED BODIES - delete these, do not merely unreference them. Tranche 7 left an
orphan tenants_in_common body exactly this way and it nearly produced a duplicate:
SHELL_CLOSING_STATEMENT__ntd__v1__closing_statement
SHELL_TENANT_BLOCK__ntd__v1__tenant_signature_block
Both must also be removed from the tranche-7 closing-frame position's position_bodies.
The tranche-7 closing-frame position (emit_order 100) is REPLACED by the five positions
below. SHELL_LANDLORD_BLOCK__ntd__v1__landlord_signature_block is unchanged and is
re-referenced by the new landlord position; do not delete or re-create that body.

canonical_bodies.body_text: This Letter of Intent is non-binding, except as expressly stated herein. It will be superseded by, and the parties will only be bound by, the terms of a written lease agreement, in form and substance satisfactory to both parties, which has been fully executed and delivered by the parties. The lease document will contain a provision allowing for electronic or digital signatures, which electronic or digital signatures will be deemed binding by the parties. Until and unless the parties mutually execute a lease, either party may terminate the negotiations contemplated herein at any time, for any reason, and without liability or further obligation (except in regards to its confidentiality obligation) to the other party, by providing written notice of termination to the other party. Notwithstanding the nonbinding nature of this Letter of Intent, Landlord acknowledges that Starbucks deems each of the terms of this Letter of Intent as material terms that serve as the basis for Starbucks’ decision to move forward with lease negotiations and that (i) any subsequent demands by Landlord for deviations from the terms of this Letter of Intent or (ii) delays in providing documentation specified herein or as further requested by Starbucks, may result in significant delays and a termination of lease negotiations.

clauses.description: The Tenant execution block, template paras 220-226. A three-way alternative set: the template as drafted, and the two forms Oculus has actually sent.
clauses.guidance_note: CLAUDE CODE CHANGE (report to Mike): tranche 8 encoded these as alternatives riding letter_shell. That shape cannot load - an 'alternative' may not carry emit_order, modifies_clause_id or selector_value, and letter_shell's variant already holds a rank-0 alternative and an is_default. A ranked ladder needs its own variant, and a variant is deal-type scoping, so the set needs its own clause. Emission position is preserved by template_paragraph 220, not by clause membership.
